thread:
alex: Heads-up — EU reserved GPU pool provisioning is blocked for the new customer org (acct 0xA7). Payments gateway flagged the payment method: VAT ID mismatch. Stripe UI shows "Validation failed: VAT ID format" and marked charge as high-risk. This is preventing creation of the billing profile so A100s won't spin up in eu-west-1.

maya: Ugh. Can you paste the exact error text or a screenshot? Is this the EU VAT vs company registration name mismatch we've seen before? :confused:

leah-finance: We got the same error on 2 recent customers — finance needs a company registration doc + VAT certificate that matches the "legal_name" on the payment instrument. If the name is abbreviated on the bank statement it fails automated matching. We can manually approve but need docs uploaded to the payments portal.

alex: Error snippet from Stripe: `payment_method.error: invalid_vat_number - VAT ID could not be validated via VIES` 
Also transaction logs show 402 decline with code `vat_mismatch` and risk score 0.82.

sam: Short-term mitigation: we can route the provisioning to our global shared pool (no billing profile required) but cost is ~2x and it's not allowed for regulated customers. For this org they specifically requested VPC/private deployment in eu-west-1.

ops-oncall: If we move them to shared fallback it will break data residency promises. We need finance to approve manual exception or confirm VAT docs today.

leah-finance: I can do a manual review but need: (1) company registration extract, (2) VAT certificate or VIES screenshot, (3) bank statement showing legal name. Email to pay-ops@redwood.com or upload to the portal link IDM. Once I clear it, I'll kick the billing profile creation task.

alex: Thanks — I've pinged the customer to send docs. FYI the billing-bot also auto-posted: `billing-bot: Provision request 8492 failed: payment_source_invalid (vat_validation_error) — retry blocked`.

maya: Can we add a temporary hold reason on the infra ticket so SRE doesn't waste cycles spinning workers?

ops-oncall: Done — tagged the infra ticket with `billing-hold/vat` and set priority to P2. If docs don't arrive within 24h we'll schedule a call with the customer's procurement team.

leah-finance: If they can't provide VAT, we can accept OSS self-declaration for small organizations, but that still requires a manual KYC step. I'll start the exception workflow now.

sam: One more note for runbooks — let's add a quick checklist: VAT validation failure -> request docs -> hold infra provisioning -> manual KYC within 24h -> escalate to finance lead if >24h. Saves us repeating this.

alex: Agree. I'll draft the checklist and drop it in #eng-infra-docs after we close this thread. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: billing-bot: Customer 0xA7 set to `pending_manual_review` by leah-finance.
